scope: root exports and package export-map subpaths
summary: The current beta keeps the broad root import surface, but the compatibility promise is tiered. Stable/latest promotion requires an approved narrowing or explicit support commitment for monitor and preview surfaces.

beta-supported-core.label: Beta-supported core
beta-supported-core.supportPromise: Documented components, props, exported public types, composition behavior, accessibility semantics, and CSS import paths should remain compatible through beta except for approved breaking changes with migration notes.
beta-supported-core.stableEligibility: Eligible for stable after visual QA, docs, external-consumer evidence, and dependency policy checks pass.

beta-supported-composition-conditional.label: Beta-supported composition / product primitives
beta-supported-composition-conditional.supportPromise: Importable and beta-supported while their Storybook/autodocs, focused tests, and packed-consumer coverage remain green. Missing evidence should downgrade the family before stable/latest.
beta-supported-composition-conditional.stableEligibility: Needs authored composition guidance or equivalent usage docs before stable.

monitor-high-risk.label: Monitor / high risk
monitor-high-risk.supportPromise: Importable during beta but not promised as a stable compatibility contract. API changes require release notes; stable promotion requires explicit owner and additional evidence.
monitor-high-risk.stableEligibility: Needs owner, adopter use case, browser or interaction evidence where relevant, and migration policy.

preview-experimental-candidate.label: Preview / experimental candidate
preview-experimental-candidate.supportPromise: Importable in the broad beta root but should move behind an approved preview/experimental boundary or become private before stable unless YZ explicitly approves support.
preview-experimental-candidate.stableEligibility: Not stable-eligible without explicit design-engineering approval.

subpathPolicy../layout: Support high-level layout primitives after responsive/docs evidence; monitor style helpers, constants, chrome internals, and hooks.
subpathPolicy../media: High risk. Needs browser/media lifecycle evidence before stable compatibility.
subpathPolicy../media/lightbox: Preview unless the headless composition/state/context contract is intentionally supported.
subpathPolicy../preview: Public preview boundary; exports are not covered by the stable compatibility promise.
subpathPolicy../theme: Document appearance UI; monitor controller factories, auto-color internals, option tables, and personalization utilities.
subpathPolicy.css: Every package export-map CSS entry is API. Removing, renaming, or consolidating a CSS path is an API change.

stableBlockers: Move or explicitly approve preview-experimental-candidate symbols before stable/latest.
Document root-to-preview migration guidance for preview-experimental-candidate symbols.
Assign owners and evidence requirements for monitor-high-risk symbols in docs/design-system/ui-react-monitor-evidence-matrix.md.
Document conditional composition families before promising stable compatibility.
Keep the generated export inventory in sync with this policy in CI.

previewMigration.rootPolicy: The broad beta root remains importable, but preview-experimental-candidate symbols are not stable-root-eligible by default.
